messages:
maya: Heads-up — I observed a regression on SM90 after switching default to Triton FA2. Sharing bench summary and profiler excerpts for triage.
bench-bot: automated: gpt-like bench seq=512 batch=8 model=gpt-j runs=30
maya: env: SM90 nodes, CUDA=12.3, Triton=2.2.0. Command: python bench_attention.py --kernel triton_fa2 --batch 8 --seq 512 --model gpt-j --runs 30
sam: Local comparisons:
SM80 | CUDA 12.1 | cuda_fused         | seq512 batch8 => p50=48ms p95=120ms tokens/s=2140
SM90 | CUDA 12.3 | triton_fa2         | seq512 batch8 => p50=55ms p95=150ms tokens/s=1810 (-15%)
SM90 | CUDA 12.1 | cuda_fused         | seq512 batch8 => p50=49ms p95=125ms tokens/s=2050
maya: profiler (nsys) condensed:
cudaLaunchKernel: 14.8s total (many small launches)
cudaMemcpyAsync: 3.2s total (many tiny D2D copies)
flash_attn_forward: avg 0.8ms count ~1200
GPU idle gaps ~0.4ms
sam: nv stats on SM90:
flash_attn_triton: occupancy=0.42 shared=48KB l2_miss=18% warp_stalls=21%
cuda_fused: occupancy=0.67 shared=32KB l2_miss=9% warp_stalls=8%
alex: lower occupancy and higher stalls match small-launch fragmentation. Could be Triton codegen differences for sm_90/CUDA12.3.
maya: KV cache issue: runtime did many small KV uploads with Triton+paged KV path -> many D2D memcpy ops.
runtime trace: KVCache::append(prefix=64) -> D2D memcpy 256KB x120
kevin: hypothesis: triton FA2 tiling/codegen on sm90 creates many micro-launches for our short-request distribution; cuda_fused has bigger fused kernels -> fewer launches.
maya: quick A/B suggested policies:
- prefer cuda_fused on SM90 when batch>=8 or seq<=1024
- prefer triton_paged for seq>1024
- coalesce KV uploads to reduce memcpy count
sam: KV coalesce patch (window=200ms) reduced memcpy count ~6x; p95 improved ~18% on triton_fa2 SM90:
SM90 triton_fa2 w/kv-coalesce: seq512 batch8 => p50=52ms p95=123ms tokens/s=1950
alex: please open PR opt-in; add perf tests. Also add per-model override for kernel selection.
infra-bot: scheduled canary rollout: eng-runtime/dedicated -> 10% capacity kernel-selection v2 at 2024-07-16T22:00Z
kevin: also test FA2 variant tilings and a tuned CUDA kernel for sm90; I'll run overnight.
maya: short term: enable KV coalesce + kernel-selection policy; long term: reduced repro + Triton issue. I'll add nsight logs and bench scripts to PR.
sam: I'll own canary dashboards (p50/p95, memcpy_count, kernel_launches).
kevin: If canary p95 drops >5% we rollback. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
bench-bot: archived logs s3://redwood-perf/bench/1718500000-sm90-triton-fused-paged
